# Anime Cover Catalog API

> Public, read-only REST API to browse a curated anime catalog (~254 titles):
> titles, metadata and cover images. JSON over HTTPS, no API key, CORS open to
> any origin, edge-cached. This file is the complete API reference for LLMs and
> agents — reading it is sufficient; there is no need to scrape the HTML pages.

Base URL: `https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1` (all paths below are
relative to it; the API also works from any deployment origin).

Machine-readable spec: `/api/v1/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.0). Interactive docs:
`/api/v1/docs` (Swagger UI). Human guide: `/docs`.

## Endpoints

- `GET /api/v1` — discovery index (JSON links to every endpoint and to this file)
- `GET /api/v1/animes` — paginated, filterable, sortable list
- `GET /api/v1/animes/random` — one random anime; honors the list filters; never cached
- `GET /api/v1/animes/{slug}` — single anime by its stable slug (404 if missing)
- `GET /api/v1/filters` — distinct genres, themes, demographics, types and years in the catalog

## GET /animes — query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | string ≤ 100 chars | — | Searches title, English and Japanese titles. Case- and accent-insensitive (`roze` matches "Rozé"). |
| `genre` | string | — | One value or comma-separated list, e.g. `Romance,Comedy` (OR). Case-insensitive. Unknown value → 400. |
| `theme` | string | — | Same semantics as `genre`. |
| `demographic` | string | — | Same semantics as `genre`. |
| `type` | string | — | Same semantics as `genre`, e.g. `TV,Movie`. |
| `year` | integer | — | Exact release year. A year with no entries returns an empty list (not 400). |
| `fields` | string | all fields | Comma-separated subset of fields to return, e.g. `slug,title,genres`. Unknown name → 400. Also accepted by `/animes/{slug}` and `/animes/random`. |
| `sort` | `title` \| `year` | `title` | Sort field. |
| `order` | `asc` \| `desc` | `asc` | Sort direction. |
| `page` | integer ≥ 1 | `1` | Page number. |
| `limit` | integer 1–100 | `24` | Items per page. |

Filter semantics: different parameters combine with AND; commas inside one
parameter combine with OR. `?genre=Romance,Comedy&theme=School` means
(Romance OR Comedy) AND School. Valid facet values come from `GET /api/v1/filters`.
Repeating a parameter (`?genre=A&genre=B`) is not supported (400) — use commas.

## List response envelope

```json
{
  "data": [ /* Anime objects */ ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 24, "total": 254, "totalPages": 11 },
  "links": {
    "next": "https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1/animes?page=2",
    "prev": null
  }
}
```

`links.next` / `links.prev` are absolute, ready-to-follow URLs that preserve the
active query parameters; `null` on the first/last page.

## Anime object

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `slug` | string — stable identifier, e.g. `ao-no-hako` |
| `title` | string |
| `titleEnglish` | string \| null |
| `titleJapanese` | string \| null |
| `images` | `{ "cover": string, "alternatives": string[] }` — absolute image URLs |
| `releaseYear` | integer \| null |
| `studios` | string[] |
| `type` | string, e.g. `TV`, `Movie` |
| `demographic` | string \| null, e.g. `Shounen` |
| `themes` | string[] |
| `genres` | string[] |
| `explicitGenres` | string[] |
| `episodes` | integer \| null |
| `synopsis` | string |
| `trailerUrl` | string \| null |

## Errors

Every error uses the same JSON shape: `{ "error": "<message>" }`.

- `200` — success
- `304` — Not Modified (your `If-None-Match` ETag is current; empty body)
- `400` — invalid parameter: `limit` > 100, unknown `fields` name, or a facet value not present in the catalog (message points at `/api/v1/filters`)
- `404` — unknown `slug`, or no anime matches the filters passed to `/animes/random`
- `429` — rate limit exceeded (see below); back off and retry

## Caching, conditional requests and rate limit

- Responses are edge-cached (`Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800`); data changes only on deploy. Exception: `/animes/random` is `no-store`.
- Every 200 carries an `ETag` that changes only on deploy. Re-fetch with `If-None-Match` to get `304` with an empty body.
- Rate limit: 100 requests per minute per IP → `429`. Cache on your side and use `fields` to trim payloads; typical usage never hits it.

## Examples

```bash
curl "https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1/animes?genre=Romance,Comedy&fields=slug,title,genres&limit=5"
curl "https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1/animes/ao-no-hako?fields=title,synopsis,studios"
curl "https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1/animes/random?genre=Romance"
curl "https://animecovercatalog.vercel.app/api/v1/filters"
```

## Fair use & license

- Please build something new — don't clone this catalog into the same kind of product. The API is open for other uses: apps, integrations, experiments.
- Metadata is extracted from public sources (e.g. MyAnimeList) and curated by this project. Cover images belong to their respective rights holders — credit the original works.
- Educational, non-commercial use. Provided as-is, with no uptime guarantee.
